author: van Neerven, Ramadan, et al.

steps.title: Generate lentiviral particles
steps.instruction: In a BSL‑2 laboratory, produce lentiviral particles over 5 days using lipofectamine transfection of the 3rd‑generation packaging system together with plasmids LeGO‑V2 (Addgene #27340, mVenus) and LeGO‑C2 (Addgene #27339, mCherry). This protocol is not compatible with 2nd‑generation plasmids.

steps.title: Prepare ENR culture medium
steps.instruction: Make ENR medium (Advanced DMEM/F‑12) by adding per 500 mL: 450 mL DMEM/F‑12, 5 mL N‑2 supplement (1×), 10 mL B‑27 supplement (1×), 5 mL GlutaMAX (1×), 5 mL HEPES (10 mM), 5 mL Antibiotic‑Antimycotic (1×), 1 mL N‑Acetyl‑L‑cysteine (1 mM). Store at 4 °C (DMEM/F‑12 at –20 °C, supplements at –20 °C).

steps.title: Pre‑treat organoids with CHIR‑99021
steps.instruction: At least 3 days before transduction, add CHIR‑99021 to ENR medium to a final concentration of 10 µM (inhibits GSK3β) and culture organoids in 50 µL Matrigel domes in 24‑well plates. Maintain one full well of untransduced organoids as a negative control.

steps.title: Transduce organoids with lentivirus
steps.instruction: Use two full wells of organoids (≈50 µL Matrigel domes each) per transduction. Add the lentiviral supernatant to the wells and incubate for 2 days under the same CHIR‑99021‑supplemented ENR conditions. Alternative: stimulate Wnt pathway with Wnt3a instead of CHIR‑99021.

steps.title: Prepare cells for FACS sorting
steps.instruction: Remove ENR medium, add 250 µL Cell Recovery Solution per 50 µL Matrigel dome, pipette ~10× to dissociate, pool organoids, incubate on ice 30 min, centrifuge 4 min at 480 × g, discard supernatant, add 250 µL TrypLE, incubate 37 °C for 4 min, add 1 mL ice‑cold 1 % FCS/PBS to neutralize, pipette, centrifuge 4 min at 480 × g, wash once with 1 mL FCS/PBS, centrifuge again, resuspend pellet in 250 µL FCS/PBS, transfer to FACS tubes, keep on ice.

substeps.instruction: 40. Remove ENR medium from wells.
41. Add 250 µL Cell Recovery Solution per dome; pipette up/down ~10×; scrape if needed.
42. Transfer suspension to sterile 15 mL tube; incubate on ice 30 min.
43. Centrifuge 4 min at 480 × g; discard supernatant.
44. Add 250 µL TrypLE to pellet.
45. Incubate 37 °C for 4 min.
46. Prepare ice‑cold 1 % FCS/PBS (FACS buffer).
47. Add 1 mL FACS buffer to neutralize TrypLE; mix.
48. Centrifuge 4 min at 480 × g.
49. Wash pellet with 1 mL FACS buffer; pipette ~5×; centrifuge 4 min at 480 × g. If pellet remains sticky, repeat wash until fully dissociated.
50. Remove supernatant; add 250 µL FACS buffer.
51. Transfer cell suspension to FACS tubes.
52. Prepare collection tubes containing 1 mL pre‑warmed ENR medium (37 °C).
53. Add DAPI to final 10 µM immediately before acquisition.

steps.title: Sort fluorescent organoid cells
steps.instruction: Using a BD FACSAria III (85 µm nozzle, 200–3000 events/s), set gates with an untransduced control: FSC‑A vs SSC‑A for cells, FSC‑H vs FSC‑W for singlets, DAPI‑negative for live cells, and appropriate laser channels (mCherry: 616/23 nm, mVenus: 530/30 nm). Sort positive cells into pre‑warmed ENR medium, then centrifuge 4 min at 480 × g, resuspend in Matrigel (10 000 cells per 50 µL), and culture with 10 µM CHIR‑99021 and 10 µM ROCK inhibitor (Y‑27632).

substeps.instruction: 54. Determine gating using negative control.
55. Gate cell population (FSC‑A vs SSC‑A).
56. Gate singlets (FSC‑H vs FSC‑W).
57. Gate live cells (DAPI‑negative, 405 nm laser, 450/50 nm filter).
58. Gate mCherry+ (616/23 nm laser).
59. Gate mVenus+ (530/30 nm laser).
60. Sort all positive cells.
61. Collect sorted cells, centrifuge 4 min at 480 × g.
62. Embed 10 000 cells in 50 µL Matrigel per well (24‑well plate) and culture in ENR + 10 µM CHIR‑99021 + 10 µM Y‑27632.

steps.title: Prepare collagen neutralization buffer
steps.instruction: For 1 mg/mL collagen I, mix per reaction: 0.285 mL of 3.5 mg/mL Collagen I stock with 0.715 mL neutralization buffer (final 1 mL). Neutralization buffer (per 1 mL) contains 6 mL 53 mmol/L NaHCO₃, 2 mL 20 mmol/L HEPES, 0.575 µL 1 N NaOH, 10 mL 1× PBS, and sterile water to 71.5 mL total. Filter through 0.2 µm filter and store at 4 °C up to 6 months.

substeps.instruction: Prepare buffer components as listed in Table 3.
Combine reagents, filter, and store.

steps.title: Form collagen hydrogels
steps.instruction: Neutralize Collagen I to 1 mg/mL (1 mL per well). Gently mix collagen stock with neutralization buffer, pipet 1 mL onto each well of a 6‑well plate (or 500 µL per well of a 12‑well plate), incubate 1 h at 37 °C to gel. Store plates up to 1 month at 37 °C with 1 mL PBS per well (refresh PBS or seal with parafilm to prevent drying).

substeps.instruction: 13. Mix calculated volumes of Collagen I and neutralization buffer.
14. Pipet 1 mL onto one well of a 6‑well plate.
15. Incubate 1 h at 37 °C.

steps.title: Set up 3D organoid co‑cultures
steps.instruction: One day before plating, pre‑warm 24‑well plates. Verify organoid density (≈full well). Remove ENR medium, add 250 µL Cell Recovery Solution per 50 µL Matrigel dome, pipette to disrupt, combine both fluorescent populations in a sterile 15 mL tube, incubate on ice 30 min, centrifuge 4 min at 480 × g, discard supernatant, resuspend pellet in cold Matrigel (≈30 µL extra to avoid bubbles), plate 50 µL per well, let dome solidify 15 min (turn plate upside down after 5 min), add 500 µL pre‑warmed ENR medium, incubate 37 °C, 5 % CO₂. Plate 10 000 cells per 50 µL Matrigel if using sorted cells.

substeps.instruction: 1. Pre‑warm 24‑well plates (≥1 day).
2. Inspect well confluency under microscope.
3. Remove ENR medium.
4. Add 250 µL Cell Recovery Solution to each dome; pipette up/down to disrupt.
5. Transfer both organoid suspensions to one 15 mL tube; mix thoroughly.
6. Incubate on ice 30 min.
7. Centrifuge 4 min at 480 × g; discard supernatant.
8. Resuspend pellet in cold Matrigel (add ~30 µL extra).
9. Plate 50 µL Matrigel‑organoid mix per well of pre‑warmed plate; mix by pipetting between wells.
10. Incubate 15 min at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ (turn plate upside down after ~5 min).
11. Add 500 µL pre‑warmed ENR medium to each well.
12. Return plate to humidified incubator (37 °C, 5 % CO₂).

steps.title: Optional fused co‑culture preparation
steps.instruction: Mechanically disrupt organoids, mix suspensions in Eppendorf tubes, centrifuge 480 × g for 4 min, discard supernatant, resuspend pellet in small volume of ENR medium, incubate 37 °C for 30 min to allow fragments to adhere, centrifuge again, discard supernatant, embed in Matrigel domes as above.

steps.title: Analyze images with ImageJ
steps.instruction: Open ImageJ, load scanned images, split fluorescence channels (Image → Color → Split Channels), adjust color balance, set display range, adjust brightness/contrast, set threshold (use ‘Default’ algorithm), run Analyze → Analyze Particles with Size = 100‑Infinity, Circularity = 0.00‑1.00, Show = Outlines, check ‘Display results’, copy area measurements to Excel, optionally set scale to convert pixels to µm².

substeps.instruction: 44. Open ImageJ.
45. Import images.
46. Image → Color → Split Channels.
47. Image → Adjust → Color Balance.
48. Set display range for each channel.
49. Image → Adjust → Brightness/Contrast.
50. Set display range again if needed.
51. Image → Adjust → Threshold (Default algorithm).
52. Analyze → Analyze Particles (Size 100‑Infinity, Circularity 0.00‑1.00, Show Outlines).
53. Tick ‘Display results’.
54. Copy area data to Excel.
55. Set scale (Analyze → Set Scale) to convert pixels to µm² if required.

steps.title: Co‑culture flow cytometry analysis
steps.instruction: Prepare samples as in steps 40‑51 (cell dissociation, DAPI 10 µM). Using a BD LSRFortessa (100‑1000 events/s), set gating with single‑fluorophore controls: FSC‑A vs SSC‑A for cells, FSC‑H vs FSC‑W for singlets, DAPI‑negative for live cells (405 nm laser, 450/50 nm filter), mCherry+ (612/23 nm laser), mVenus+ (530/30 nm laser). Acquire data, calculate the ratio of mCherry⁺ to mVenus⁺ cells; optional use BD Trucount tubes for absolute cell counts.

substeps.instruction: 55. Follow steps 40‑51 to obtain single‑cell suspension.
56. Add DAPI to 10 µM before acquisition.
57. Gate cell population (FSC‑A vs SSC‑A).
58. Exclude doublets (FSC‑H vs FSC‑W).
59. Gate live cells (DAPI‑negative).
60. Detect mCherry⁺ (612/23 nm laser).
61. Detect mVenus⁺ (530/30 nm laser).
62. Compute mCherry⁺/mVenus⁺ ratio; use Trucount beads if absolute numbers are needed.
